verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents several pieces of self-serve onboarding: a free tier you can sign up for, free spreadsheet import to bring in real data, and Zia AI that can create modules, reports and workflows quickly. Nothing in the evidence shows signup-to-working-pipeline in under an hour, a guided onboarding or migration wizard, or that founders manage this without an implementation partner. Missing for 10: guided onboarding/setup wizard, documented pipeline or deal-stage setup, time-to-value evidence, migration from other CRMs, hands-on or independent corroboration of no-partner self-serve setup.

support.subject: As a founder, I can go from signup to a working pipeline with my real data in under an hour, without an implementation partner

citations.quote: Import data from spreadsheets for free.
Zia can create modules, reports, and workflows in seconds
